questions.explain: Yes. The six takes the checking nine, so both center backs keep the line connected.
choiceExplanations: Then nobody takes the nine, so it turns freely in front of your back four.

questions.q: The forward drops, then the picture changes. Put these moments in order, first to last.
options: Your six takes the checking nine
Near center back steps with cover
questions.explain: Right. The six takes the nine first, then the ten blocks that handoff, so the center back steps.

questions.q: Now the nine receives on the right, and the ten still occupies your six. Drag the right center back.
options: Step to the nine with cover
questions.explain: Yes. The six is busy with the ten, so the near center back steps while the partner covers.
choiceExplanations: Retreating lets the nine turn and run at your line with no pressure.
